longTitle: Zhongyu was awarded the PhRMA Foundation Value Assessment and Health Outcomes Research Predoctoral Fellowship.
summary: Zhongyu Li was awarded the PhRMA Foundation Value Assessment and Health Outcomes Research Predoctoral Fellowship.for her project 'Type 2 Diabetes Subtypes for Precision Medicine in Electronic heAlth Records – Cancer (T2D-SPEAR Cancer)'. She is one of nine recipients from all over the United States.
